title: I Let the Municipal Pool Pass Survive Three Weekends After They Waived the Desk

parts.text: Weekend one they waived the desk scan and posted a paper pass on the turnstile. I was thirty-eight, lap swimmer, holding a membership that still beeped one gate. At 8:11 a.m. the paper opened lap and, I found, the slide. Temporary, aquatics said. I photographed the paper, both gates, the time. Then a group I did not recognize used the same paper toward the diving well. I asked once, then I documented twice. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized group just used the paper pass toward the diving well.

social.video_title: They posted a paper pass on the turnstile — Part 1/3
social.description: Desk waived, a paper, a group toward diving. Would you have followed the pass?

parts.text: Weekend two I followed with the stills. The well took the same stamp. The group palmed a speaker that was not a lap errand I could see from the cone. I was still thirty-eight, still beeping, suddenly the file. I messaged aquatics the still and stayed in the camera. The group looked at the cone, then at the last gate on the party deck. I stayed in the frame and forwarded without commentary. Petty is a word people use when their name is on the ticket.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the party-deck gate; aquatics now has the still.

social.video_title: The same stamp opened the diving well — Part 2/3
social.description: A speaker off-lap, a camera cone, party deck next. Aquatics has the still. Do you stay in the cone?

parts.text: Aquatics locked the party deck from the booth. The group left the speaker and the paper. Morning recoded all three gates. The waiver who called it temporary lost the stamp. I keep a membership that beeps one gate. Turnstiles scan now, not papers. The pool at 8:11 sounds like a pool, which is to say water and nobody's stamp. Nobody thanked me, which is how you know a policy finally works. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: Morning recoded all three gates — Part 3/3
social.description: Left paper, a lost stamp, turnstiles that scan. Was temporary ever a party deck?
